label: mcp-stop-request-lifetime-ready1
implementation: begin_stop seals only original connection admission and wakes admitted requests; it no longer cancels SDK before exact request cancellation.
Each admitted request retains its original peer/requestId and connection-local active guard through official cancellation acknowledgement or bounded unknown receipt.
Disconnect waits original connection request guards for2seconds then still reclaims child/SDK on timeout or unconfirmed cancellation, returning cleanup failure.
Tools/list uses the same existing request_raw so no unbounded separate admission path remains.
Direct future Drop transfers active ownership into existing cancellation cleanup guard; old connection lifetime cannot cancel a newly connected one.
checksPrepared: Existing real stdio case retains original scope/deadline/drop/echo assertions and additionally tests begin_stop rejection with zero delivery, exact cancellation arrival before close, final active0 and reconnect surviving old lifecycle cancellation.
Real remote resource test retains actual remote drop+zeroactive within unchanged3seconds and records negotiated protocol versions in addition to wire/handler/ct/DELETE observations.
limitations: No claim remote cleanup fixed until actual SDK server counters show release.
Official rmcp modern HTTP consumes notify_cancelled locally to cancel the exact HTTP request; wire notification count0 alone is valid and not a failure.
Official transport/SDK/network reused; no hand-written MCP messages/client or larger timeout.
